name: Chika's Father
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c21992]Chika's[/url] father. His beloved daughter describes him as a "traditional papa-man". She respects and loves him very much and it's reciprocal. His weak points are the pastries, his wife and, above all, his daughter.

He sees his daughter as a super cute goddess. He is very kind to her but a bit less with the boys of her age, but  easily agrees with them when they compliment her.
